module_title: Intermediate Timeline - Civic Rights, Agricultural Milestones, and Key Professions
introduction: This level covers dates related to civic empowerment, the Indian constitution, and specialized professions. These dates are frequently tested in State PCS and RO/ARO exams, often requiring you to know the underlying historical reason for the date's selection.

core_concepts.title: Civic Rights and Institutional Foundations
core_concepts.description:
- **January 24: National Girl Child Day** ➡️ Initiated by the Ministry of Women and Child Development in 2008 (also coincides with the day Indira Gandhi took the oath as India's first female PM in 1966).
- **January 25: National Voters' Day** ➡️ Celebrates the foundation day of the Election Commission of India (ECI), established on January 25, 1950.
- **November 26: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas)** ➡️ Marks the adoption of the Indian Constitution by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.

core_concepts.title: The High-Yield December Trio
core_concepts.description:
These three back-to-back dates in December are massive favorites in competitive exams:
- **December 22: National Mathematics Day** ➡️ Birth anniversary of the mathematical genius Srinivasa Ramanujan.
- **December 23: Kisan Diwas (Farmers' Day)** ➡️ Birth anniversary of the 5th PM of India, Chaudhary Charan Singh.
- **December 25: Good Governance Day** ➡️ Birth anniversary of former PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

core_concepts.title: Professional Tributes
core_concepts.description:
- **July 1: National Doctors' Day** ➡️ Honors the birth and death anniversary of the legendary physician and second Chief Minister of West Bengal, Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy (B.C. Roy).
- **September 15: National Engineers' Day** ➡️ Birth anniversary of the legendary civil engineer Sir M. Visvesvaraya.

important_entities.name: National Voters' Day (Jan 25)
important_entities.significance: Started in 2011 to encourage more young voters to take part in the political process. The date was specifically chosen because the ECI was formed exactly one day before India became a Republic (Jan 26, 1950).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: A vast majority of students mistakenly believe February 28 is C.V. Raman's birthday. **It is not.** He was born on November 7. February 28 (1928) is solely the date he publicly announced the discovery of the **Raman Effect**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Math (22) helps Farmers (23) achieve Good Governance (25)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Use this narrative chain to lock in the three consecutive December dates: Ramanujan's Math (22) -> Charan Singh's Farmers (23) -> Vajpayee's Governance (25).

exam_strategy_tips: For UPSC Prelims and PCS, pay attention to 'Constitution Day' (Nov 26). Before 2015, this day was primarily celebrated as 'National Law Day'. The Modi government officially rebranded it as Constitution Day in 2015.
